# External Files

Files under this folder are considered external files. Files in this folder come from sources such as meeting interviews, 
documents provided by the client, meeting transcripts, etc. While all files under this folder are important, they are not 
final. Files in this folder may become outdated very quickly and should not be used as a source or directive unless another 
file directly references it (business-rules.md references bookbuddies-profile-notes.md for example). And under no circumstances 
should AI be making a decision based off the info stored in this folder, any question like "What database should I pull books from?"
should be answered by a human and put in the requirements folder. It can however, be used to help summarize. But always remember
check for correctness and AI should always cite whenever they access something in this folder.
